title: Shop Portfolio Web Application
description: A scalable, high-end e-commerce platform for clothing and jewelry, featuring an AI-driven recommendation engine.
caseStudyDetails:
The Request

The client wanted a luxurious online presence for their high-end clothing and gold jewelry store. They specifically requested a modern UI with an AI system that could track user browsing patterns and suggest complementary pieces (e.g., matching a gold necklace with a specific dress type).

Development Process

We built the application using ASP.NET Core MVC for a robust backend and Entity Framework for complex inventory management. We integrated Azure OpenAI to process user behavior data in real-time, feeding personalized recommendations to the frontend dashboard.

title: School ERP System
description: An integrated student and fee management system utilizing ML.NET to predict student dropout risks.
caseStudyDetails:
The Request

A regional educational trust needed to centralize operations across 5 campuses. They required standard ERP features (attendance, fees, staff management) but also wanted an AI capability to flag students at high risk of dropping out based on attendance and fee payment patterns.

Development Process

We developed a highly responsive Blazor WebAssembly frontend communicating with an ASP.NET Core Web API. For the AI component, we trained a custom classification model using ML.NET, which ingests historical student data from PostgreSQL to generate daily risk reports for administrators.

title: Web & WhatsApp Bot with AI
description: An automated customer support solution combining a modern web dashboard and a WhatsApp bot powered by Semantic Kernel.
caseStudyDetails:
The Request

The client was overwhelmed by WhatsApp inquiries and needed an intelligent bot that could not only answer FAQs but also qualify leads and schedule appointments directly into their system.

Development Process

We architected a C# .NET 8 service acting as the webhook for the WhatsApp Business API. We integrated Semantic Kernel to orchestrate calls to Azure AI, allowing the bot to maintain context, understand conversational nuances, and automatically push qualified lead data to the client's internal dashboard.

title: College Portfolio Builder
description: An interactive platform for students to build professional portfolios, leveraging Azure AI Vision for automated certificate tagging.
caseStudyDetails:
The Request

A university wanted a centralized platform for students to showcase their work to potential employers. They needed a feature where students could upload bulk documents (certificates, hackathon photos) and have them automatically categorized.

Development Process

We built the frontend with React and the backend with ASP.NET Core. When a student uploads an image, the backend streams it to Azure AI Vision, which performs OCR and object detection to extract skills and automatically generate tags (e.g., 'Java Developer', 'First Prize'), saving students hours of manual data entry.

title: Custom Web Application
description: A modular enterprise web application custom-built for specific client requirements, featuring AI-powered data visualization.
caseStudyDetails:
The Request

An enterprise client needed a custom internal tool to unify their disjointed data sources. Crucially, executives wanted to be able to type natural language questions (e.g., 'Show me sales for Q3') and have the application generate dynamic charts instantly.

Development Process

We deployed a suite of C# Microservices in Docker containers. We utilized the OpenAI API to translate natural language queries into complex SQL/GraphQL queries against their unified Redis and SQL databases. The frontend then dynamically renders the resulting data using advanced charting libraries.
